# cook-docs

> Rust CLI for automatically generating standardized Markdown documentation from Cooklang (`.cook`) recipes using Go-compatible templates (`gtmpl-ng`).

`cook-docs` recursively scans directories (or targets explicit recipe paths), parses `.cook` recipes with `cooklang`, resolves companion images (`.webp`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`) with optional asset copying and WebP conversion, enriches output with emojis, gram weight conversions, category tags, ingredient/step cross-links, and scaling helpers, supports non-destructive `--merge`, live `watch` mode, `doctor` diagnostics, Zensical/MkDocs `--nav-file` sync, `self-update`, shell completions, and man page generation.

## Core Modules

- [src/main.rs](src/main.rs): CLI entrypoint, logger setup, subcommand dispatch, recipe discovery, and batch rendering.
- [src/lib.rs](src/lib.rs): Library root exporting `config`, `cook`, `doctor`, `document`, `enrichment`, `merge`, `nav`, `types`, `update`, and `watch`.
- [src/config.rs](src/config.rs): Configuration loader merging defaults, TOML/YAML/JSON config files (`figment`), `COOK_DOCS_*` env vars, and CLI args (`clap`).
- [src/cook.rs](src/cook.rs): `.cook` file discovery (`.cookdocsignore` aware), output/image path resolution, category tag resolution, ingredient/cookware aggregation, AST step cross-linking, and Cooklang parsing.
- [src/document.rs](src/document.rs): Built-in `gtmpl-ng` templates, custom template helpers (`emoji`, `titleEmoji`, `toGrams`, `linkRecipe`, `scale`, `toYaml`, `totalTime`, etc.), Markdown formatting, asset copying/WebP conversion, and output writing.
- [src/enrichment.rs](src/enrichment.rs): Emoji mapping table, ingredient density/weights table (with `exclude_small_units_except`), and internal recipe cross-link index.
- [src/merge.rs](src/merge.rs): Non-destructive Markdown merge (marker regions and structure-aware section/frontmatter/reference preservation).
- [src/nav.rs](src/nav.rs): Format-preserving navigation sync for Zensical (`zensical.toml`) and MkDocs (`mkdocs.yml` / `mkdocs.yaml`).
- [src/doctor.rs](src/doctor.rs): Config, template, output, nav file, and recipe validation (`--check-recipes`, `--only`, `--strict`, `--json`).
- [src/watch.rs](src/watch.rs): Debounced filesystem watcher (`notify`) for automatic recipe and template re-rendering.
- [src/update.rs](src/update.rs): GitHub release self-updater (`self-update` / `update`).
- [src/types.rs](src/types.rs): Serializable data structures (`Config`, `Recipe`, `Info`, `Step`, `Ingredient`, `IngredientAmount`, `Cookware`, `Timer`).
- [tests/integration_tests.rs](tests/integration_tests.rs): Unit and integration test suite covering path helpers, config precedence, and parsing.
- [tests/regression_tests.rs](tests/regression_tests.rs): End-to-end CLI regression suite covering rendering, merge, enrichment, doctor, watch, assets/WebP, and nav sync.

## Build & Automation

- [Cargo.toml](Cargo.toml): Rust crate manifest (Edition 2024) and dependency specifications.
- [Taskfile.yaml](Taskfile.yaml): Task runner automation (`test`, `fmt`, `lint`, `lint:md`, `spellcheck`, `completions`, `man`, `coverage`, `dry-run`, `serve`, `dist`, `build-all`, `release`).
- [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml): Python environment (`zensical`) for building the static documentation site via `uv`.
- [zensical.toml](zensical.toml): Zensical static site configuration and navigation.
- [.github/workflows/ci.yaml](.github/workflows/ci.yaml): Multi-target CI workflow (`test`, `rustfmt`, `clippy`, `docs`, `yamllint`, `markdownlint`, `typos`, `coveralls`).
- [.github/workflows/release.yaml](.github/workflows/release.yaml): Tag-triggered multi-arch release build, `.deb` packaging, and Homebrew/Scoop/APT publication.
